newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates unchanged, liquidity good.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates unchanged, liquidity good.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained steady to slightly lower on Thursday amid good liquidity, dealers said.

"The banks' accounts have been fuller over the past few days. Banks have been trading with caution prior to Friday's public holiday that may result in them needing extra funds on Saturday," a dealer told Reuters.
Fresh deals totalled 39.6 million kuna and covered all of the demand. Some 30 million kuna remained on the supply side.
Call money deals accounted for 33.6 million kuna trade. Most of those deals were struck at 10.5 percent with a single borrowing made at 8.5 percent, the lender being a foreign bank.
One four-day loan was struck at 10.5 percent and one-week loans were granted at a slightly lower 9.0 percent rate and at 11 percent, the first granted by a foreign bank.
Wednesday's overnight trade totalled two million kuna sought by one bank to cover its shortfalls. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
